//: Standalone runtimeconfig consumed by netcorehost's initialize_for_runtime_config. dotnet build also emits one next to the DLL; this committed copy documents the expected shape and lets the Rust host boot even when pointed at a directory that only holds the DLL + this file. Targets the .NET 8 shared runtime (Microsoft.NETCore.App).
//keep-in-sync-with-csproj: Every configProperty ShimadzuGlue.csproj sets must appear here too, or the documented DLL-only deployment behaves differently from a `dotnet build` output. EnableUnsafeBinaryFormatterSerialization was missing here for one release and is REQUIRED, not optional: Shimadzu.LabSolutions.IO 5.0.0.0 (ProteoWizard 3.0.26151+) deserializes part of the .lcd through BinaryFormatter, which .NET disables by default since .NET 5, so without it LoadData throws NotSupportedException and every .lcd looks unreadable.
